about: Nothing but bad shots, one day / one outfit (white Nike tee, navy cap + pants) from your YouTube round 'Worst Course in the Country' (#1 worst course.mov). 12 bits back to back, each cut before you talk: opens on the drive into the water, then the topped shots, the 'pretty terrible drive', the 90-degree slice, a second ball in the water, the last-hole flubs, ending on the one you had to fish out. Natural sound only, no music, no text, no shirt wipe. Vertical crop follows you (no scorecard in this video). Transcript of the final file: empty (no speech). Unreleased-video footage. 40 s.
